papers.title: Ryder: Epigenome normalization using a two-tier model and internal reference regions
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Sequencing-based epigenomic profiling methods are powerful but suffer from technical variability that complicates cross-sample comparisons and can obscure true biological signals. While existing normalization methods using spike-in controls or computational approaches have been proposed, they often rely on assumptions that may not hold across diverse experimental conditions or require additional data types. Results We present Ryder, a flexible and robust Python package for the normalization of epigenomic signal tracks. Ryder leverages stable internal reference regions, such as invariant CTCF binding sites, to correct for technical artifacts genome-wide. Our results show that it effectively adjusts both background noise and signal intensity, ensuring accurate signal alignment across samples while preserving genuine biological differences. We demonstrate that Ryder performs robustly across diverse assays including DNase-seq, CUT&RUN, ATAC-seq, MNase-seq, and ChIP-seq, with or without spike-in controls. By reducing technical noise, Ryder improves the detection of genuine biological changes, such as quantitative reduction of chromatin accessibility at key enhancer elements by depletion of BRG1, a key subunit of the chromatin remodeling BAF complexes. Availability and Implementation The Ryder source code, documentation and test data are freely available at: https://github.com/YaqiangCao/ryder . The software version used in this study is archived at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21267457

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
基于测序技术的表观基因组分析方法具有强大的分析能力，但其技术变异性会干扰样本间的比较结果，甚至掩盖真实的生物学信号。尽管目前已有多种使用人工添加的对照序列或计算方法进行数据标准化处理的技术，但这些方法往往依赖于某些在不同实验条件下可能不成立的假设，或者需要额外的数据类型来辅助分析。  

**研究结果**  
我们开发了Ryder这一灵活且可靠的Python工具包，用于对表观基因组数据分析结果进行标准化处理。该工具利用基因组中稳定的内部参考序列（如不变的CTCF结合位点）来消除技术性干扰。实验结果表明，Ryder能够有效调整背景噪声与信号强度，确保不同样本间的数据具有可比性，同时保留真实的生物学差异。我们在多种测序技术中验证了Ryder的适用性，包括DNase-seq、CUT&RUN、ATAC-seq、MNase-seq以及ChIP-seq等；无论是否使用人工添加的对照序列，Ryder都能稳定地发挥其作用。通过有效降低技术性噪声，Ryder显著提升了对真实生物学变化的分析能力——例如，在BRG1这种染色质重塑复合体的关键亚基被去除后，相关增强子区域的染色质可及性会显著下降，而Ryder能够准确检测到这一变化。  

**软件资源与使用说明**  
Ryder的源代码、文档及测试数据均可免费获取，链接为：https://github.com/YaqiangCao/ryder。本研究使用的软件版本已存档在Zenodo平台上，链接为：https://zenodo.org/records/21267457。

papers.title: Revisiting Batch Effect Correction: A Structured Problem Formulation and Novel Solutions
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Existing methods for batch effect removal often suffer from an ill-defined problem formulation and rely on unverified assumptions, limiting their robustness and generalizability. This study proposes a principled approach to systematically address these limitations. Results We present two novel methodologies for removing systematic batch effects: an unsupervised approach based on independent component analysis and a supervised approach using a domain adaptation technique. Both methods are grounded in rigorous mathematical principles. Our approaches outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets. Availability and Implementation The implementation of our methods, including all code, datasets, experimental workflows, and supplementary material, is available in Python and has been made publicly accessible on GitHub: https://github.com/shaham-lab/revisiting-batch-effect-removal , Supplementary Material: https://github.com/shaham-lab/revisiting-batch-effect-removal/blob/main/proofs/suplementery_matirial.pdf

papers.title: PanRes: A database of latent and acquired antimicrobial resistance allowing 3D-based protein homology search
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Antimicrobial resistance databases are central to genomic surveillance, but resistance determinants remain distributed across resources with different scopes, structures, and annotations. Results We developed PanRes, a curated resistance database of 11 717 genes integrating acquired and latent determinants of antibiotic, biocide, and metal resistance within a unified ontology. We predicted representative protein structures and clustered them by structural similarity, grouping proteins into 505 high-confidence structurally conserved clusters coherent despite sequence divergence. Their structure-guided alignments were used to build Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) for remote homology search. In seven wastewater metagenomes from five European cities, PanRes 3D-based HMMs expanded detection beyond what was possible with BLAST, with 35.3% of retained hits identified only by the HMMs and generally showing greater divergence from known proteins. For beta-lactamases, several proteins retained beta-lactamase-like folds and catalytic geometry despite weak sequence similarity. Availability and implementation PanRes is available through an interactive web platform ( https://panres.rambio.dk/ ), a structure-informed resource for exploring the whole resistome. The database, HMM profiles, and ontology are available at Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.22876216)

抗微生物药物耐药性数据库在基因组监测中发挥着核心作用，但相关耐药性决定因子分散于不同来源的数据库中，这些数据库在数据范围、结构及注释信息方面存在差异。为此，我们开发了PanRes这一整合了抗生素、杀菌剂及金属耐药性相关决定因子的专业数据库。该数据库包含11,717个基因的信息，所有这些决定因子都被纳入统一的本体框架中进行管理。我们预测了这些蛋白质的结构，并根据结构相似性将它们聚类为505个高度保守的蛋白群组；尽管这些蛋白在序列上存在差异，但它们的结构特征仍然保持一致。基于这些结构信息构建的隐马尔可夫模型被用于远缘同源性的检测。在来自欧洲五座城市的七份废水宏基因组数据中，PanRes所建立的隐马尔可夫模型显著提升了检测效率：其中35.3%的阳性结果仅通过该模型才能被识别出来，而这些蛋白质与已知蛋白质之间的序列差异通常也更大。对于β-内酰胺酶而言，尽管这些蛋白质在序列上相似性较低，但它们仍保留着类似的折叠结构及催化机制。

all_papers.title: Ryder: Epigenome normalization using a two-tier model and internal reference regions
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Sequencing-based epigenomic profiling methods are powerful but suffer from technical variability that complicates cross-sample comparisons and can obscure true biological signals. While existing normalization methods using spike-in controls or computational approaches have been proposed, they often rely on assumptions that may not hold across diverse experimental conditions or require additional data types. Results We present Ryder, a flexible and robust Python package for the normalization of epigenomic signal tracks. Ryder leverages stable internal reference regions, such as invariant CTCF binding sites, to correct for technical artifacts genome-wide. Our results show that it effectively adjusts both background noise and signal intensity, ensuring accurate signal alignment across samples while preserving genuine biological differences. We demonstrate that Ryder performs robustly across diverse assays including DNase-seq, CUT&RUN, ATAC-seq, MNase-seq, and ChIP-seq, with or without spike-in controls. By reducing technical noise, Ryder improves the detection of genuine biological changes, such as quantitative reduction of chromatin accessibility at key enhancer elements by depletion of BRG1, a key subunit of the chromatin remodeling BAF complexes. Availability and Implementation The Ryder source code, documentation and test data are freely available at: https://github.com/YaqiangCao/ryder . The software version used in this study is archived at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21267457

all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
基于测序技术的表观基因组分析方法具有强大的分析能力，但其技术变异性会干扰样本间的比较结果，甚至掩盖真实的生物学信号。尽管目前已有多种使用人工添加的对照序列或计算方法进行数据标准化处理的技术，但这些方法往往依赖于某些在不同实验条件下可能不成立的假设，或者需要额外的数据类型来辅助分析。  

**研究结果**  
我们开发了Ryder这一灵活且可靠的Python工具包，用于对表观基因组数据分析结果进行标准化处理。该工具利用基因组中稳定的内部参考序列（如不变的CTCF结合位点）来消除技术性干扰。实验结果表明，Ryder能够有效调整背景噪声与信号强度，确保不同样本间的数据具有可比性，同时保留真实的生物学差异。我们在多种测序技术中验证了Ryder的适用性，包括DNase-seq、CUT&RUN、ATAC-seq、MNase-seq以及ChIP-seq等；无论是否使用人工添加的对照序列，Ryder都能稳定地发挥其作用。通过有效降低技术性噪声，Ryder显著提升了对真实生物学变化的分析能力——例如，在BRG1这种染色质重塑复合体的关键亚基被去除后，相关增强子区域的染色质可及性会显著下降，而Ryder能够准确检测到这一变化。  

**软件资源与使用说明**  
Ryder的源代码、文档及测试数据均可免费获取，链接为：https://github.com/YaqiangCao/ryder。本研究使用的软件版本已存档在Zenodo平台上，链接为：https://zenodo.org/records/21267457。

all_papers.title: Revisiting Batch Effect Correction: A Structured Problem Formulation and Novel Solutions
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Existing methods for batch effect removal often suffer from an ill-defined problem formulation and rely on unverified assumptions, limiting their robustness and generalizability. This study proposes a principled approach to systematically address these limitations. Results We present two novel methodologies for removing systematic batch effects: an unsupervised approach based on independent component analysis and a supervised approach using a domain adaptation technique. Both methods are grounded in rigorous mathematical principles. Our approaches outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets. Availability and Implementation The implementation of our methods, including all code, datasets, experimental workflows, and supplementary material, is available in Python and has been made publicly accessible on GitHub: https://github.com/shaham-lab/revisiting-batch-effect-removal , Supplementary Material: https://github.com/shaham-lab/revisiting-batch-effect-removal/blob/main/proofs/suplementery_matirial.pdf

all_papers.title: PanRes: A database of latent and acquired antimicrobial resistance allowing 3D-based protein homology search
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Antimicrobial resistance databases are central to genomic surveillance, but resistance determinants remain distributed across resources with different scopes, structures, and annotations. Results We developed PanRes, a curated resistance database of 11 717 genes integrating acquired and latent determinants of antibiotic, biocide, and metal resistance within a unified ontology. We predicted representative protein structures and clustered them by structural similarity, grouping proteins into 505 high-confidence structurally conserved clusters coherent despite sequence divergence. Their structure-guided alignments were used to build Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) for remote homology search. In seven wastewater metagenomes from five European cities, PanRes 3D-based HMMs expanded detection beyond what was possible with BLAST, with 35.3% of retained hits identified only by the HMMs and generally showing greater divergence from known proteins. For beta-lactamases, several proteins retained beta-lactamase-like folds and catalytic geometry despite weak sequence similarity. Availability and implementation PanRes is available through an interactive web platform ( https://panres.rambio.dk/ ), a structure-informed resource for exploring the whole resistome. The database, HMM profiles, and ontology are available at Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.22876216)

all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
抗微生物药物耐药性数据库在基因组监测中发挥着核心作用，但相关耐药性决定因子分散于不同来源的数据库中，这些数据库在数据范围、结构及注释信息方面存在差异。为此，我们开发了PanRes这一整合了抗生素、杀菌剂及金属耐药性相关决定因子的专业数据库。该数据库包含11,717个基因的信息，所有这些决定因子都被纳入统一的本体框架中进行管理。我们预测了这些蛋白质的结构，并根据结构相似性将它们聚类为505个高度保守的蛋白群组；尽管这些蛋白在序列上存在差异，但它们的结构特征仍然保持一致。基于这些结构信息构建的隐马尔可夫模型被用于远缘同源性的检测。在来自欧洲五座城市的七份废水宏基因组数据中，PanRes所建立的隐马尔可夫模型显著提升了检测效率：其中35.3%的阳性结果仅通过该模型才能被识别出来，而这些蛋白质与已知蛋白质之间的序列差异通常也更大。对于β-内酰胺酶而言，尽管这些蛋白质在序列上相似性较低，但它们仍保留着类似的折叠结构及催化机制。  

**数据库的可用性与应用**

We predicted representative protein structures and clustered them by structural similarity, grouping proteins into 505 high-confidence structurally conserved clusters coherent despite sequence divergence.
